json_exact.visible_heading: Get them following you before sharing the link
json_exact.notice: Credit card will be needed later

json_exact.result: State remains off; upgrade dialog shown
json_exact.visible_heading: Collect emails in DMs with our Essential plan

json_exact.visible_state:
- button:
- paragraph: Engage more. It’s Essential
- heading "Follow up with those who forgot with Essential" [level=1]
- paragraph:
  - text: Not everyone clicks the link the first time. A timely nudge goes a long way for anyone who forgot about your DM. Creators like you send follow-ups all the time with the Essential plan.
  - text: Try it for free (if you haven’t had a free trial before), and cancel anytime if you’re not feeling it.
- heading "Keep engagement flowing with Essential:" [level=2]
- list "Keep engagement flowing with Essential:":
  - text: Launch as many automations as you like
  - text: Say hi to new followers automatically
  - text: Collect emails through customizable DMs
  - text: No limits on story replies
- button "Get Essential":
  - generic: Get Essential
- generic: Credit card will be needed later

visible_headings: Reply to all your posts and reels with Essential
Have your reply ready for your next post with Essential

json_exact.observed_text: When someone clicks the button in your Opening DM, it starts a two-way chat so you can do way more than just send a link.

unavailable_controls: a DM asking to follow you before they get the link
a DM asking for their email
a follow up DM if they don't click the link

selection.choose_when: Use a small comment-to-link wizard with an opening DM and client-supplied destination.
selection.avoid_when: Do not choose for a scored quiz or deterministic qualification. Follow/email/no-click options require an upgrade here.

safety.delivery_limit: No Set Live or send action. Scoped 0 runs before trigger removal and n/a list metrics are not account-wide no-delivery proof.

gaps: Original server settings and IDs were not exported. Clone defaults are not asserted to equal source defaults.
Runtime was not tested because execution is forbidden; this is separate from settings completeness.
a DM asking to follow you before they get the link: State remains off; upgrade dialog shown
a DM asking for their email: State remains off; upgrade dialog shown
a follow up DM if they don't click the link: Upgrade dialog; switch remains off
any post or reel: Upgrade prompt; no plan change
next post or reel: Upgrade prompt; no plan change
